title: Checks Studio source artifact
description: Compiled Playwright source artifact for a Studio UI test revision. Architecture "Checks UI Studio" v2.1 §4.4. Exactly one entry per source line, index aligned, with identical originalText. This document is the single source of truth; backend/src/main/resources/studio/artifact.schema.json is a byte-identical build fixture guarded by ArtifactSchemaDriftTest.

steps.description: Ordered compiled steps. Index aligned with the authored source lines: steps[i].stepIndex === i.

stepIndex.description: Zero-based position of the authored source line this step was compiled from.

originalText.description: The authored English line, byte-identical to the source. Never rewritten by the compiler.

code.description: Generated Playwright TypeScript for this step. Restricted to the §4.5 permitted language; the runner revalidates before execution.
